title: 10-minute Problem Interview Script
summary: Fast discovery interviews that validate frequency and willingness.
body:
# 10-minute Problem Interview Script

## Setup
- Thanks for chatting. I’m researching a workflow problem, not pitching.
- I’ll ask about your last experience, then I’ll shut up and listen.

## Questions
1) Walk me through the last time this happened.
2) What did you do instead? (workaround)
3) What part was the most annoying and why?
4) How often does this happen? (daily, weekly, monthly)
5) What have you tried that did not work?
6) If a simple tool fixed this, what would it need to do in the first version?
7) Would you try a lightweight MVP if I sent it this week?

## Close
- Can I follow up after I build a first draft?
- Who else should I talk to that has the same problem?

title: MVP Scope Checklist
summary: A checklist to prevent scope creep and keep the MVP shippable.

## Core promise
- In one sentence: the MVP helps users ________.

## One core workflow

- Timebox (days/weeks):
- Tools:

## Acceptance criteria
- The MVP is done when:
  - A user can complete the main workflow end to end
  - The output is understandable and usable
  - You can measure activation

## Launch
- Who are the first 10 users?
- How will you invite them?
- What feedback question will you ask after first use?
